en.title: Advocates Warn of Potential Return to Disability Institutions Amid Policy Shifts
en.summary: Advocates warn that recent U.S. federal actions on special education, civil commitment, and disability rights could lead to a resurgence of institutional care for people with disabilities. Meanwhile, Yuanta Securities secured the top AAA certification for accessible web pages, a UK study projects £176 billion economic gains from fully accessible public transport, a WMU student was honored with the first Horseshoe Pin for raising an accessibility concern, and a tweet flags rising fraud in disability service facilities amid lax oversight.

highlights.title: Why Advocates Fear a Return to Disability Institutions
Yuanta Securities builds a finance-friendly environment, obtains the highest AAA certification for accessible web
Making public transport fully accessible could boost UK economy by £176bn
Student receives first WMU Horseshoe Pin from President Kavalhuna for acknowledgement of accessibility issue - Western Herald
Concerns over fraud in disability service facilities and lack of oversight

zh-TW.title: 倡導者警告美國聯邦特殊教育等行動恐致殘障機構捲土重來
zh-TW.summary: 倡導者警告，美國最近在特殊教育、民事承諾和殘障權利方面的聯邦行動可能導致對殘障人士的機構照護再次增加。同時，群益證券獲得無障礙網頁 AAA 最高認證，英國報告指出完全無障礙公共交通可增加1760億英鎊經濟效益，西密歇根大學學生獲首枚WMU馬蹄釘以表彰其指出無障礙問題，而JR East推文表示將準備支援精神障礙手冊使用者。

highlights.title: 倡導者擔心殘障機構將再次回歸
